# [TASK] Upgrade react-router-dom v5 → v7 and migrate route API

## Task
Install react-router-dom@7. Migrate from `useHistory` to `useNavigate`, `Switch` to `Routes`, and `Redirect` to `Navigate`. Update `src/components/App.jsx` and any other files using the v5 API.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `npm ls react-router-dom` shows 7.x. — `react-router-dom@7.18.2` installed (`package.json`, `package-lock.json`).
- [x] No `<Switch>`, `useHistory`, or `Redirect` usage in `src/`. — Migrated: `App.jsx` (`Switch`→`Routes`, `Route` now uses `element`), `Actors.jsx`/`VoiceControl.jsx` (`useHistory`→`useNavigate`, `history.goBack()`→`navigate(-1)`, `history.push(x)`→`navigate(x)`), `Profile.jsx`/`AdminDashboard.jsx` (`Redirect`→`Navigate` with explicit `replace` to preserve v5's replace-by-default redirect semantics). Repo-wide grep confirms zero remaining v5-only APIs (`useHistory`, `Redirect`, `Switch`, `withRouter`, `useRouteMatch`).
- [x] All routes resolve correctly in the running app. — Verified two ways: (1) full Vitest suite (166/166 passing) exercises real `MemoryRouter`/`Routes` navigation, including a `useNavigationType()` check confirming the `Navigate` redirects in `Profile.jsx`/`AdminDashboard.jsx` classify as `REPLACE` not `PUSH`; (2) a `vite build` + `vite preview` smoke test with a headless browser hitting `/`, `/movie/1`, `/actors/1`, `/admin`, `/profile/1` against the real production bundle — each route mounted the correct component, and the unauthenticated `/admin` and `/profile/1` routes correctly redirected client-side to `/`, landing on the same Movies-page state as a direct `/` visit (the "An error has occurred" text on those pages is the Movies/MovieInformation/Actors components' own TMDB-fetch-failure UI, expected since no backend services are running in this checkout — unrelated to routing).

## Estimate
**Hours:** 3

## Verification notes
- `npm test` — 166/166 passing.
- `npm run lint` — clean, no warnings.
- `npm run build` — 0 errors.
- Independent code-review subagent pass: no bugs found.
- Independent test-review subagent pass found two real gaps (no test verified `Navigate`'s `replace` semantics; `Profile.test.jsx`'s redirect test was vacuous — wrong `renderWithProviders` option name meant it never actually navigated, and it asserted on Profile's own absent content rather than a redirect sentinel). Both fixed: `Profile.test.jsx` rewritten to use a sentinel-route pattern matching `AdminDashboard.test.jsx`, and both files now assert `useNavigationType() === 'REPLACE'` after the redirect.

Commits: `4e0dd88` (migration), `3d9ebc9` (test-review fixes).
